title: Level 2 (Intermediate) - C-21
notes:
West leads the ♦6 against 6♠ doubled. East's double of a freely bid slam is a Lightner double, calling for an unusual lead, usually dummy's first bid suit. West obediently leads a diamond. South seems to have at least 12 top tricks (6 spades, the ♥A, 3 diamonds, and 2 clubs). The only possible danger is that East may be ruffing one of South's diamond tricks.

A low diamond should be played from dummy at trick 1. When East ruffs, South must be careful to unblock the ♦A. South can win any return, draw trump, and take the marked finesse against West's ♦J. Dummy's remaining diamond honours will take care of South's 2 heart losers.
